pass_2.reason: The ratio check remained advisory and the wide sunglass silhouette was accepted manually for a provider-compatibility test. This was a risk, not a clean automated pass.

try_on.prompt: Cinematic product-modelling fashion video, vertical 9:16, 15 seconds, inside a modern open-plan office with clean desk surfaces, soft diffused overhead light, floor-to-ceiling windows with a city view beyond, polished professional atmosphere. Medium front three-quarter portrait of the same character wearing the exact black sunglasses from the product reference. CRITICAL PHYSICAL FIT: render the frame at realistic optical scale, only 88 to 95 percent of her face width; both outer hinges must sit at her temples and must not extend beyond the sides of her face. The bridge rests naturally on her nose and the temples travel straight toward her ears. Keep the exact rectangular frame shape, black colour, silver hinge hardware and tinted lenses identical to the product reference. Keep her exact identity, skin tone, hair and taupe waistcoat outfit. Natural skin texture and visible pores, candid office photograph, no text, no invented accessories.

payload.negative_prompt: blur, distorted face, plastic skin, morphing eyewear, extra fingers, text

video_request.prompt: Cinematic product-modelling fashion video, vertical 9:16, 15 seconds, inside a modern open-plan office with clean desk surfaces, soft diffused overhead light, floor-to-ceiling windows with a city view beyond, polished professional atmosphere. She wears EXACTLY the same outfit, hair and accessories shown in the start-image — do NOT change clothing, hair colour, jewellery or skin tone. She wears the exact eyewear from the product reference — keep the frame shape, colour, rim and lenses IDENTICAL in every shot; never morph, warp, recolour, or add/remove parts. 10 distinct editorial shot moments: [1] medium front, she stands tall, chin level, direct gaze to camera, shoulders rolled back; [2] she slowly rotates 30 degrees right, chin raised, shoulders drawing back with the turn; [3] camera moves closer — frame rim and lenses in sharp focus, soft bokeh behind her; [4] she raises one hand and adjusts the frame on her nose bridge, precise and deliberate; [5] full right profile — clean frame silhouette crisp, she holds an elegant composed pose; [6] she pivots back through 3/4 to face camera, hair catching the light as it settles; [7] camera pulls slightly wider — she shifts her weight to one hip, hand resting at her side; [8] she tosses her hair off one shoulder with a fluid sweep, snaps eyes back to camera; [9] camera drifts forward — lenses catching the warm raking light, bridge sharp; [10] final medium front — she steps forward slightly, shoulders square, full confident gaze. Real natural skin texture with visible pores, NOT airbrushed; soft natural light. No on-screen text, no captions.

implementation_notes: The fal.ai compatibility fix was to send an explicit 9:16 aspect ratio and one assembled prompt instead of a manufactured multi_prompt payload.

The full PM validation called run_modelling but monkeypatched the try-on function to reuse the previously generated pass-2 still. It validates downstream orchestration; it is not a literal end-to-end UI click-through.
The prompt asks for 10 editorial moments in 15 seconds, approximately 1.5 seconds per beat. That density is a likely creative failure contributor.
The source log says 18-20 cut multishot, but the actual submitted prompt contains 10 distinct moments. The log label is stale.
